'''Erl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] crew commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Voss (Imperial officer)|Voss]]. Their ship was part of the [[secret armada]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel]], tasked with transporting a mysterious creature known as the [[teezl]] to the Imperial [[Coruscant/Legends|capital]]. However, their ship was hit by an attack of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] piloting modified [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], and Voss immediately ordered Erl and his crewmates to return fire. Erl and one other member of the crew were skeptical of their chances of surviving the sneak attack.<ref name="marvel61" />
